nodeGuidance.external_json_action: Call a JSON-returning external tool; set command_env and action, then connect result onward.

nodeGuidance.browser_journey: Run fixed Playwright cases after preparing the browser URL and test cases; publish or assess evidence.
nodeGuidance.run_browser_smoke: Quickly verify essential screens after deployment; retain each iteration's browser evidence and optionally fail on an unpassed case.
nodeGuidance.validate_source_contract: Before browser validation, require configured source patterns or files in the target repository.
nodeGuidance.validate_tailwind_source: Before a Tailwind UI journey, verify its stylesheet or Tailwind configuration and browser prerequisites.
nodeGuidance.run_source_aware_browser_journey: After source validation, verify the rendered result and retain per-iteration evidence and an artifact.
nodeGuidance.explore_rendered_site: Explore a bounded set of safe same-origin links and collect URLs, visible text, and screenshots.
nodeGuidance.custom_script: Use only for small Python logic the catalog cannot express; write JSON-safe output values.
nodeGuidance.state_load: Reuse state from a prior run or iteration; connect state to planning, assessment, or the next action.
nodeGuidance.state_save: Persist value for later iterations, such as journey progress, failure history, or an accumulating decision.
nodeGuidance.require_test_cases: Place first when fixed test cases are required; it stops the runner early if they are absent.
nodeGuidance.snapshot: Save or restore changes across iterations; choose the lifecycle operation that matches the recovery flow.
nodeGuidance.model_prompt: Generate, summarize, or analyze free-form model output; connect text result to logs, evidence, or the next AI step.
nodeGuidance.model_json: Produce a JSON decision, classification, or plan for a following node.
nodeGuidance.ai_agent: Delegate tool-using work such as code investigation or change proposals to a coding agent.
nodeGuidance.emit_evidence: Record connected inputs under a namespace in the OpenOrbit result; place after an important intermediate result.
nodeGuidance.log_message: Leave a human-readable progress marker when no result data needs publishing.
nodeGuidance.validate_command_environment: In Before All, confirm the required command environment variable before any external command runs.
nodeGuidance.validate_build_fields: Require build settings such as a browser URL before connecting actual actions.
nodeGuidance.validate_browser_runtime: Confirm the required browser URL field before beginning a user or persona journey.
nodeGuidance.validate_browser_journey_contract: In Before All, require both the browser URL and fixed cases for a continuous journey.
nodeGuidance.initialize_user_journey_state: Create or restore recurring journey progress and failure history; share its namespace with following journey nodes.
nodeGuidance.plan_user_journey: Retry failed cases first or choose the next fixed case; place directly before running the journey.
nodeGuidance.run_user_journey: Run the planned fixed browser journey and connect its evidence to handoff, publishing, or supervision.
nodeGuidance.publish_user_journey_handoff: In After Each, retain this iteration's result and the state needed by the next one.
nodeGuidance.validate_persona_contract: Before an autonomous persona journey, require the browser target and persona cases.
nodeGuidance.observe_persona_page: Capture the current page, safe available links, and evidence before choosing the persona's next action.
nodeGuidance.plan_persona_action: Choose one safe next action from the observed page and persona goal.
nodeGuidance.run_persona_action: Follow the planned safe link and record page evidence; destructive actions are excluded.
nodeGuidance.reflect_persona_session: In After Each, retain learnings, issues, and next intent for the next persona iteration.
nodeGuidance.validate_git_repository: At the start of native improvement, verify the target is a Git worktree for recovery and isolated work.
nodeGuidance.validate_improvement_inputs: Require fixed AI cases and a model profile before executing or assessing a prompt.
nodeGuidance.prepare_managed_prompt: Prepare an approved or comparison candidate prompt so baseline and candidate share inputs.
nodeGuidance.exercise_managed_prompt: Run every fixed request through the prepared prompt to form a comparable response set.
nodeGuidance.assess_prompt_candidate: After prompt execution, judge candidate stability against its baseline and connect the verdict onward.
nodeGuidance.retain_improvement_iteration: Save the recovery point and evidence before applying a candidate or external change.
nodeGuidance.restore_improvement_baseline: Restore the original target without a commit at iteration end or after a rejected candidate.
nodeGuidance.create_agent_proposal: Create a reviewable coding-agent proposal in an isolated workspace without changing the source repository.
